summary: Release unfinished pooled read transactions at physical return and identify live snapshot candidates in WAL diagnostics.

replay.detail: No replay, source admission, authority, projection health or frontier changes.

schema.detail: No schema, index, trigger or stored data format changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint eligibility, retention or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: ReadPool rolls back unfinished read transactions only when the physical connection returns; failed cleanup closes the connection. Live and nested Store snapshots retain their single cut. Existing abnormal WAL logs gain timestamped pool-specific checkout and known snapshot ages, physical connection and bounded route/budget metadata; unknown transaction age remains null. No successful HTTP response shape changes.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon binary deployment requires a restart; restart duration has not been measured for this change.

manual.detail: No live database action, setting change or repair is required.

recovery.detail: No persistent migration. Binary rollback restores the prior reader return behavior and diagnostic fields.
